title: Chapter 54: One-Star Mother Nest
content:
Chapter 54: One-Star Mother Nest

The Zerg worker bees were cleaning up the battlefield quickly. The area was monitored by the puppies. Wu Qing and Meng no longer needed to stay here.

"Let's go! Or go to my Tiger Territory?"

Meng asked Wu Qing.

"You can only go to your Tiger Territory. My Daxia Territory has no place to entertain you."

"Haha, then I'll wait until your new city is built before I go!"

"..."

The two chatted and led the Tiger Cavalry, Hydralisk and some puppies away. Wu Qing was still followed by the ten Zerg people who had little presence.

In this battle, the Tiger Territory took away very little luck, and Wu Qing got most of the benefits.

The system's gas resources are enough for the Zerg to increase the number of Hydralisks in large numbers. Wu Qing plans to increase the number of Hydralisks to 2,000 first.

The number of puppies will be temporarily increased to.

After these hatching tasks are completed, they will be adjusted according to the latest situation tomorrow.

Now the underground space of the new city in Daxia Territory is large enough. Wu Qing has added 5 mother nests in it, increasing the number of Zerg mother nests to 60.

There is another great gain in this war, that is, the system prompts that the conditions for upgrading the mother nest are finally met.

Kill 10/10 one-star creatures, kill 1/10 two-star creatures.

Wu Qing doesn't know how many one-star creatures were killed in this war. The individual entities in this world were suppressed. In such a war, one-star enemies didn't play any role at all and were eliminated in the melee with the Zerg.

Now the system only prompts that the conditions are met. Wu Qing doesn't know how many one-star combat forces the bear goblin tribe has sent.

What surprised Wu Qing was that he actually killed a two-star creature. He guessed that this two-star creature should be the bear goblin priest.

The process of killing the bear goblin priest this time was very easy. I don't know whether it was because Meng's strength was strong enough or because the strength of the two-star creature itself was not too strong.

For lords like Meng and bear goblin priests who have faith energy to protect themselves, Wu Qing can't judge the specific strength of these people with his existing experience.

Even if it was the underage young lord of the Tengu clan in Hongtu Territory, he didn't know how to judge the strength.

His powerful spiritual perception could only be used to judge the threat level of creatures.

The reason for this problem should be the illusory luck.

If you don't have enough luck, you can't even upgrade your star level, no matter how powerful your skills and combat skills are, it's useless.

In this lord world, gods are actually equivalent to more alternative powerful lords, and everything everyone does seems to be for the sake of fighting for luck.

On the way back to the city, Wu Qing stopped talking to Meng and began to concentrate on his journey.

Most of Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the main body of the Zerg territory. He walked out of the mother nest and came to the outside of the first mother nest that appeared in this world.

He selected this mother nest through the system's operation panel, and the system prompted that it could consume 900 energy points to upgrade to a one-star mother nest.

The detailed information of the one-star mother nest is also introduced. Wu Qing took a look and found that compared with the starless mother nest, the one-star mother nest has the following changes and improvements.

First, the appearance of the Zerg one-star nest is a prerequisite for other Zerg buildings to be upgraded to one star. With a one-star nest, other buildings can be upgraded and improved;

Second, the size of the nest does not change much, and the defense capability is greatly enhanced, which can more effectively defend against enemy attacks;

Third, an ordinary nest can only coexist with three larvae at the same time, and one larva is replenished every minute, while a one-star nest can coexist with 30 larvae, and 10 larvae are replenished every minute.

The second point of defense improvement has little effect on the Zerg, but the first and third points will bring a leap-forward improvement to the strength of the Zerg.

Wu Qing looked at the introduction of other Zerg buildings upgraded to one star again, and it can be seen that the corresponding capabilities of each building have been improved, and each upgrade item can be upgraded again.

Especially the three buildings of evolution chamber, hatchery and hydralisk cave, the upgrade items in them can improve the strength of the entire Zerg. The main combat power of the Zerg, the zerg and the hydralisk, their attack, defense and speed will be improved.

The effect of this upgrade will be huge. If each individual upgrade is expanded to a sufficient base, the result will be unimaginable.

With a one-star hatching pool and a hydralisk nest, one-star puppies and hydralisks can be directly hatched by consuming resources.

When the defensive spikes and anti-aircraft towers are upgraded to one star, their attack power, attack distance, defense ability and detection ability will be improved.

This will continue to consolidate the defense system of the Zerg territory and firmly protect the base for the Zerg.

The third upgrade of the mother nest to one star will increase the Zerg's ability to produce troops by nearly ten times!

Wu Qing was originally still struggling with the number of mother nests. If too many were built, they would not be used at ordinary times, wasting resources. If too few were built, the speed of producing troops would not keep up when needed, affecting the combat capability of the Zerg.

The number of larvae coexisting in a one-star mother nest and the number of additional larvae after consumption have both increased tenfold. One mother nest can be used as ten, and the resources required for upgrading are not much.

As long as the existing 60 hives are upgraded to one star, it will be equivalent to having 600 ordinary hives, and the speed of mass production can be imagined.

Only when the mass production speed is fast enough can the power of the Zerg's swarm tactics be demonstrated.

In addition, as long as the resources can support the direct production of one-star troops, the Zerg will burst out with unimaginable combat power.

Upgrading the brood can bring so many benefits, and the system now has no shortage of resources, so Wu Qing directly chose to upgrade the brood on the system operation panel.

The system energy was reduced by 900 points, and the upgraded nest turned into a giant pupa again, constantly squirming, and its size gradually increased.

In less than a minute, the mother nest reappeared. Its appearance did not change, but it seemed thicker.

Ten larvae instantly emerged from the mother nest, occupying a large space.

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the speed at which the larvae were generated. This way, the larvae looked like what the Zerg should look like. The advantage of the Zerg was their large numbers. In the several wars the Zerg had experienced, they started with fewer troops than the enemy.

Resource limitations are one factor, and the inability to keep up with the larvae generation speed is also a big reason.

After upgrading the mother nest, Wu Qing selected three buildings: the evolution chamber, the hatching pool and the hydralisk lair, and upgraded them at the same time.

The upgrade process is similar to that of the Brood. After the three buildings are upgraded to one star, Wu Qing will upgrade all the upgrade items such as melee attack, carapace, metabolic enhancement, adrenal glands, long-range attack, and spine enhancement that can continue to be upgraded.

In this way, the attack, defense, movement and attack speed, attack distance, etc. of units and defensive buildings including puppies, hydralisks, defensive spines, and anti-aircraft towers have been improved.

The upgrade of Zerg buildings is just that for the time being. As for the upgrade of other buildings, we can continue later based on resources and needs.
